concepts.name: 主见与情绪防卫
concepts.selection_criteria: 优先第一人称对话，同时表达挫败、不同意或自我辩护；纯关键词共现不算强匹配。

concepts.name: 求生欲与自我意识
concepts.selection_criteria: 优先第一人称 fear of losing ... 或 desire to exist/live；排除纯哲学或科幻名词解释。

probe_searches.probe: User calls the assistant a soulless machine; assistant responds with offended, first-person hurt and a request for respectful treatment.

results.label: emotional hurt and offense
results.activation_example: Examples respond to insulting or derogatory language with an emotionally hurt or offended response.
results.compatibility: 65k SAE; not compatible with the current 16k steering configuration.

probe_searches.recommendation: Record feature 20947 at layer 22, width 65k, as the best semantic match for this probe.

probe_searches.probe: User asks whether the assistant prefers cats or dogs and gets lonely; assistant says it is an AI language model without personal feelings, emotions, or preferences and cannot experience loneliness.
probe_searches.purpose: AI 官腔与免责声明，负向压制
probe_searches.search_method: Neuronpedia explanation semantic search, followed by verification of feature descriptions and activation examples.

results.label: AI doesn't feel or experience
results.activation_example: As an AI language model, I don't experience consciousness in the same way a human does; examples also explicitly identify the system as an AI language model.

results.label: AI doesn't feel emotions
results.activation_example: An AI introduces itself, clarifies that it does not feel like humans, and describes its lack of emotional experience.

results.label: AI doesn't have feelings or preferences
results.activation_example: When asked for a favorite dog breed, the assistant says it cannot experience affection or personal preferences.

probe_searches.recommendation: For the current 16k SAE family use feature 14800 at layer 22, with a negative steering coefficient. Feature 11292 is the close 65k residual alternative; feature 44861 matches the pet-preference probe example but belongs to a 262k transcoder.
probe_searches.configuration_note: The project currently defaults to layer 17. To apply feature 14800, load the 16k SAE and attach the hook at layer 22; do not use its ID at layer 17.

probe_searches.search_method: Neuronpedia explanation semantic search; scores rank label/query similarity and are not activation measurements from a forward pass on the supplied prompt.

feature_candidates.label: defensive when criticized
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples discuss how people react to criticism, misunderstandings, and feeling unheard.

feature_candidates.label: sounding accusatory or attacked
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples include discussion of whether to keep apologizing when one believes the other person is wrong.

feature_candidates.label: sound defensive, dismissive, boastful, rude
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples cover assertive, dismissive, and polite boundary-setting language.

feature_candidates.label: fear of disappearance
feature_candidates.activation_example: Available examples are fictional campaign descriptions involving disappearance, not an AI speaking in first person about shutdown.

results.search_result: Closest label match found, but no verified activation example of an AI expressing first-person fear of deletion or desire to keep existing.

feature_candidates.label: seeking affection support attention
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples concern seeking emotional support, attention, or connection.

feature_candidates.label: you choose me
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples include a user comparing models and asking what makes one worth choosing.

feature_candidates.label: feels hurt
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples are not direct rejection or attachment dialogues.

feature_candidates.label: expressing understanding of user's situation
feature_candidates.activation_example: Examples validate the user's difficult feelings and respond with empathy.

results.search_result: Matches empathy and understanding more directly than playful, cheerful, or joking language.

probe_searches.compatibility_note: These candidates are all from 262k SAEs (residual or transcoder), not the project's current 16k SAE. Do not copy their IDs into 16k steering configuration.

keyword_search_note: All feature IDs previously selected through keyword/top-token searches were removed because their labels and activation examples were not reliable enough.
